title: Coulomb's law (কুলম্বের সূত্র)
placement: Book page 279, topic 10.4 বৈদ্যুতিক বল: কুলম্বের সূত্র, চিত্র ১০.০৯ and the উদাহরণ with চিত্র ১০.১০ (a) and (b) (pp. 279–283).
description: Coulomb's law (book pages 279–283, topic 10.4, চিত্র ১০.০৯ and ১০.১০). Two polished metal spheres on clear acrylic (insulating) stands over a wooden metre rule printed in cm, on a plain sand bench in a calm deep-blue setting. A sphere's charge is its colour (positive red, negative blue) and always its white sign. Five steps, one tap each, slow: (1) the book's example (a): +1 C and −1 C 10 cm apart, two equal and opposite outlined teal force arrows over the spheres pull them together (আকর্ষণ); (2) the right sphere turns positive: the arrows turn round (বিকর্ষণ); (3) twice the distance: the right sphere slides to 20 cm and the arrows shrink to a quarter beside a faint ghost of the old one, and the panel's F–r graph shows the 1/r² curve with both points; (4) the law F = kq₁q₂/r², k = 9 × 10⁹ Nm²/C², worked live with the student's numbers (back at the book's −9 × 10¹¹ N), with steppers for q₁ and q₂ (−2 … +2 C) and the sphere dragged from 10 to 40 cm; (5) the book's example (b): +9 C and +16 C 1 m apart and a third charge +q between them that the student drags (or the action slides) until the two pushes on it balance, at x = 0.43 m, where the graph of the net force on +q crosses zero. A calm intro card; per step a lead-in line, the result and the rule in the book's words; the kit's drag handles, rotate cue and how-to row. Test tab: five questions (like charges, twice as far, three times the charge, the meaning of F's minus sign, the no-force point between +4 C and +1 C), each wrong choice with its own note. Phone-first, Bangla and English.
